depiction_rules.notes: A single divine swan conveying Bhagavan's Hamsa teaching in D095 S002. The deity is shown as a real swan, not as a humanoid figure with a bird head.

visual_bible.form: One graceful white swan with a natural curved neck, one beak, two wings, two legs and webbed feet.
visual_bible.plumage: Matte warm-white feathers with restrained cream and pale ochre shading.
visual_bible.divinity: A small quiet matte aureole may frame the head; no human face or extra limbs.
visual_bible.style: Flat matte South Indian temple mural drawing with firm dark contours and broad mineral color fields.

never: no humanoid torso or human face
no extra wings, legs, heads or beaks
no readable text, letters or labels
no glossy feathers, rays, beams or photorealistic rendering
